title: Live Nation's antitrust trial is underway in the U.S. What's at stake in the case?
desc: The antitrust trial between Ticketmaster’s parent company and the U.S. Department of Justice got underway with opening statements on Tuesday. The case could force a breakup of Ticketmaster and Live Nation and have ripple effects in Canada — but experts say it’s still early, and bets on the outcome are off the table.

title: Barcelona disappointed, proud as Copa rally vs. Atleti falls short
desc: Hansi Flick was "disappointed but proud" after Barcelona came desperately close to pulling off an incredible comeback against Atlético Madrid on Tuesday only to ultimately miss out on a place in the Copa del Rey final.
